# NEW 2026-11-22 v16.5 Module 16.5-B: Sovereign Finance, Central Banks & Speculative Bubble Disaster (oe_fin_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v165_finance_twilight.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Global Native Disaster: Speculative Bubble & Sovereign Debt Crash (1680-1836).
# Uses verified EU5 1.4.9 vanilla 1080x440 disaster illustration decline_of_empire.dds.
oe_fin_speculative_bubble_crash = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/decline_of_empire.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_medium
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_year >= 1680
		current_year <= 1836
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_bubble_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_fin_mod_modern_credit_order }
		num_locations >= 8
		OR = {
			is_great_power = yes
			is_colonial_overlord = yes
			has_non_rural_port = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_bubble_heat }
				var:oe_fin_bubble_heat >= 45
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		oe_fin_bubble_distress = yes
	}

	can_end = {
		oe_fin_crash_resolved = yes
	}

	modifier = {
		bank_interest = 0.035
		bond_interest = 0.035
		monthly_inflation = 0.0015
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.18
		trade_income = -0.15
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.10
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.005
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.20
	}

	on_start = {
		oe_fin_init_host = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_crash_active value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_crash_months value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_stabilization_steps value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fin.105
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_crash_months }
			change_variable = { name = oe_fin_crash_months add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_fin_crash_months value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_audit_cab_active }
			oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = { amt = -2 }
		}
		random_list = {
			6 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			94 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				94 = { }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_fin.106 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_fin.107 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_fin.108 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_fin.109 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_fin.112 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_fin.115 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_crash_active }
			remove_variable = oe_fin_crash_active
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_bubble_heat value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_fin_bubble_cooldown value = 1 years = 35 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fin.116
	}
}
